review:
1920s Chicago, where an animal mob led by a crocodile boss fights over the city. Ten lines, and the crocodile wild doubles every win it's part of.

Three scatters give 15 free spins with all wins tripled, and they can retrigger – so a wild win in the bonus pays 6x. Very high volatility, a 4,684x max and an excellent 97.1% RTP. Free spins about once every 262 spins. Savage Buffalo Spirit in a pinstripe suit.
pros: Excellent 97.10% RTP – among the highest published
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
